about: The latency round (parallax-readers:r17): not compared by pixels, timed. Each reader's bench runner loads each scene (page, atlas, first frame: its load time) then draws it 600 frames at 1/60 s steps, vsync off, each frame finished on the GPU before the clock stops (its frame time). Few and many layers, plain and with effects, and a cross-fade drawing two pages at once. The pages are other rounds'. Read by shots/.../ParallaxBench; tools/readers-health.sh shows what each reader measured.
